SELECT f.festival_number festivalNumber, f.status, t.tag_name genreTag, f.festival_name festivalName, f.start_date startDate, f.end_date endDate, f.progress_status progressStatus, f.address, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM festival_likes fl WHERE fl.festival_number = f.festival_number ) festivalLikes FROM festivals f JOIN add_tags at ON f.festival_number = at.festival_number AND at.is_main = 1 JOIN tags t ON at.tag_number = t.tag_number
AND f.festival_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{festivalName}, '%')
AND t.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{genreTag}, '%')
